selection_reasoning: These two tasks form a natural multi-hop dependency chain. The player must first open a chest to retrieve the materials needed to repair Leather Pants (leather and/or damaged Leather Pants). The chest will contain the leather pants (damaged) and leather pieces needed for the anvil repair. This creates a clear dependency: you cannot repair the pants until you've opened the chest and obtained the items inside. Both tasks are observable and verifiable — opening a chest changes the game state, and repairing leather pants produces a measurable durability change on the item. Neither task requires deep Minecraft domain knowledge beyond knowing how to interact with containers and use an anvil.

edges.reason: Player must open the chest to obtain the damaged Leather Pants and leather material needed for anvil repair

milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because the player must open the chest and take the damaged leather leggings into their inventory. The leather leggings start inside the chest (not in player inventory), so having them in inventory proves the chest was opened and items retrieved.

Uses inventory_has to check that leather was consumed during the anvil repair. The chest starts with 4 leather. After repairing the damaged leather leggings (Damage:60 out of 80 max), the player uses leather as repair material on the anvil, consuming at least 1 piece. If the player has at most 1 leather remaining (consumed at least 3 for a near-full repair), it indicates repair occurred. However, since inventory_has can only check min_count, we verify the player still has the leather_leggings (confirming they weren't lost) as the primary check. The task dependency on open_chest ensures proper ordering.

scene_description: A compact stone brick platform in a forest clearing with a chest containing damaged leather pants and leather materials, and an anvil nearby for repair. The player spawns on the platform with both objects within 3 blocks.
task_text: Open the chest to retrieve the damaged leather pants and leather, then use the anvil to repair the leather pants.
design_notes: The stone brick platform is 7x7 blocks. The chest is at ~-2 ~0 ~2 (player's front-left) and the anvil is at ~2 ~0 ~2 (player's front-right). Both are within 3 blocks of spawn. The air fill clears any trees/obstructions above the platform. The chest contains leather leggings with 60 damage (out of 75 max durability) and 4 leather pieces for repair material. The player needs experience levels to use the anvil - we may need to add /xp to ensure the player can afford the repair cost.
